title: Turn cards
_map: Turn cards (Y1–2). Big idea: quarter, half and full turns; clockwise and anticlockwise; right angles. Creative: guide Steve to treasure with direction and turn cards (his first coding).
_story: Steve can only follow cards: forward, turn left, turn right. Treasure is buried on the farm. Ismaeel plans the cards, runs them, and fixes the bugs. His first program.
_stepChain: Steve faces a way → forward moves one square → a quarter turn → right and left → a list of instructions is a program → plan cards to the treasure → fix a bug

talk.ask: What cards did you give Steve to reach the treasure?
talk.goodAnswer: something like forward 3, turn right, forward 3; any program that works.
turning a quarter of the way round, like from facing forwards to facing the side. Four quarter turns make a full turn.

handsOn: Be Steve! A grown-up gives you cards or calls out forward, turn left, turn right to guide you to a hidden toy. Then swap.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: There's treasure buried on the farm! But I can only follow cards: forward, turn left, or turn right. Can you guide me?
Forward moves Steve one square, the way he's facing. Forward, forward, forward.
Now turn right. Steve turns a quarter of the way round, on the spot, without moving square. That's called a quarter turn. Four quarter turns make a full turn, back where he started.
A list of cards for Steve to follow is called a program. Steve is facing right, 3 squares away from the treasure.

question.onRight: Yes. You planned it: 3 squares straight ahead.

1.mistake: turned when Steve was already facing the right way
1.hint: Which way is Steve facing right now? Is the treasure that way?
1.say: Steve is already facing the treasure. Turning left would point him up, away from the treasure. He only needs to go forward 3.

2.hint: Count the squares between Steve and the treasure.
2.say: Count the squares: 1, 2, 3. Forward 2 stops one square short. It needs forward 3.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: New treasure! I'm back at the start, facing up. I wrote my own program: forward 3, turn left, forward 3. Here I go!

question.onRight: Yes, you found the bug: it should turn right, not left.

0.hint: After going up, the treasure is to Steve's right. Which turn faces it that way?
0.say: After going forward 3, the treasure is to the right. Turning left points Steve the wrong way, off the edge. Change the left card to right.

question.reveal: A mistake in a program is called a bug. Swap left for right, and it works.

rule.text: A program is a list of steps. Four quarter turns make a full turn.
rule.ask: Can you say what a program is? Say it out loud. Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: A program is a list of steps for someone to follow, like Steve. A quarter turn is a quarter of the way round, and four make a full turn.

bonus.prompt: Bonus: facing up, Steve does two quarter turns to the right. Which way is he facing now?
bonus.reveal: Down! Two quarter turns make a half turn: Steve faces the opposite way.
